title: Hula 7000 Hawaii Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Hawaii Prefilled pod offers a vivid cocktail of bright, tropical flavours, with juicy, sun-ripened fruit tones like tangy Pineapple, sweet-sharp Citrus and lush Mango, and a rich, authentic sweetness. It’s a fresh, uplifting flavour that stays light across the day, ideal if you enjoy vibrant, sunny flavours. These Hula Prefilled Replacement Pods are designed for use with the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, offering a quick and convenient way to replace or swap flavours without the need for refilling or coil changes. Each pod+refill contains 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, with a 2ml draw-activated pod that is automatically topped up by the built-in 10ml refill reservoir. Delivering up to 7000 puffs (approx.), these pods feature dual mesh coil technology for consistently smooth flavour and vapour. Simply insert the pod into your Hula device and enjoy long-lasting performance with minimal fuss. Available in 20 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
